answer.book: Single polemical work, Riolan's Curieuses recherches sur les escholes en medecine de Paris et de Montpelier (1651): a front matter of prefaces and the privilege extract, a main discourse running on unnumbered pages with running heads and no chapter divisions, letters between the two faculties inside it, and additions and errata at the back.
